mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Conditions are clear at Harriet Park under a First Quarter moon. Keep your eyes peeled for the International Space Station tonight as it rises in the West Southwest over Mount Horeb and travels toward the East Northeast over Fitchburg and Madison, passing almost directly overhead. We are looking at an overnight low of 42 degrees, and there is no rain expected.

City residents can now apply for the Stormwater Utility Credit by using sustainable management practices on their property. Additionally, you can join the Sugar River Supporter program to receive an even larger credit on your bill.
We have plenty to look forward to including Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia or check out the trivia night at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving. No students were injured during the incident, and the department is currently investigating a potential collision with a traffic sign.
Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently open, so make sure to stop by before they close for the night at 10 PM.
